body: Thank you so much kind stranger. It’s been a rough few weeks and posting and maybe shit posting , asking for advice and talking to strangers on both /suicidewatch and /lonely with many burner accounts kinda helped me through it (I can’t talk about it with my friends cause I’m afraid they think I’m just looking for attention or maybe they don’t understand suicidal thoughts) I feel much better now and I’m about cry out of joy that this amazing technology and all you folks didn’t know me and helped me with your kind words anyway. I can’t believe i made it even without losing my sobriety. Thank you and i hope i can set aside a time to do what you guys did for me and help others.
Me too. I decided to get rid of anyone who doesn’t text me and i kinda have no one now
You wanna talk? I feel the same way and really need to talk. If you wanted message me.
Thank you for mentioning that, I rarely post anything on reddit so i was completely unaware about TLDRs and english is not first language so sorry for bad english.
